name: Ecruteak Gym Skull Maze & Leader Morty
summary: Enter the haunted sanctum of Ecruteak Gym to challenge Gym Leader Morty. Receive a welcoming Fresh Water from the gym attendant at the entrance. Cross a floating labyrinth suspended above an abyss: red and white skull platforms alternate phases every single second, dropping careless challengers through a pitfall trap back to the entry. Battle through Channeler Martha and Sage Takao along the suspended stones. Reach Morty's shadowy inner altar to engage in an intense 5 vs 5 duel to claim the Fog Badge, TM97, the Purple Headband, and 5 Wonder Trade tickets.

items.name: Fresh Water
items.method: Gifted by the gym attendant inside the entrance lobby

items.name: Fog Badge
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Morty upon defeating his 5-Pokémon Ghost roster

items.name: TM97
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Morty alongside the Fog Badge

items.name: Purple Headband
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Morty as a signature commemorative vanity hat

items.name: Wonder Trade Ticket (x5)
items.method: Received from Morty following your official gym victory
